items.title: Science raises $400m to expand Prima retinal implant rollout
items.summary: Science Corporation raised a $400m Series D to expand its Prima retinal implant across Europe and prepare for US entry; CE marked in July 2026, FDA route via humanitarian device exemption. Total funding now above $900m.

items.title: J&J pays $2.2B upfront for Ollin to challenge Roche’s Vabysmo
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson is buying Ollin Biosciences for $2.2bn upfront, giving it a phase 3 bispecific eye disease drug to compete with Roche’s Vabysmo.
